newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Four die in Philippine plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Four die in Philippine plane crash.

text.p: Four people were killed on Friday when a light plane carrying mourners who had attended the funeral of a murdered Roman Catholic bishop crashed on Jolo island in the southern Philippines, police said.
The victims included another bishop and a news photographer, based on identification papers recovered from the bodies, a police sergeant in Jolo said.
The two others who died were the plane's pilot and an unidentified passenger, he said.
Police said the four-seater plane had just taken off when it hit branches of a tree adjacent to the airport, caught fire and crashed.

The victims were heading for nearby Zamboanga city after attending the funeral of Bishop Benjamin de Jesus, who was assassinated outside his cathedral in Jolo on February 4. Two Moslems have been arrested as suspects in the killing.
